code:
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.api import VAR

# df columns: ['stock_ret', 'bond_ret'], already stationary
model = VAR(df)
lag_order = model.select_order(maxlags=10)
fit = model.fit(lag_order.aic)

forecast = fit.forecast(df.values[-fit.k_ar:], steps=5)
caption: select_order suggests the lag p that minimizes AIC/BIC across the whole system.
